description: La Jornada shows actual route march and justice/anti-violence demands, but whether demands were collectively directed to Mexican state policy/authorities remains pending. Official 1,500 aggregates multiple city actions.
20 Nov IPN march to SFP and 12 Nov public-worker march appear in calendars only; no retrospective source confirms actual gathering/threshold.
Targeted 13 Nov CNTE search returned 2025 items, outside this dossier. 2024 calendar says no marches expected but does not establish actual outcome/crowd of listed activities.
Spanish searches covered general/sector CDMX terms and 25N. Other states and regional archives remain incomplete; not exhaustive.
